name: Front-to-Back Layer Traversal
definition: A rendering order strategy for Matryoshka layers that processes cells in front-to-back order along the viewing direction to handle occlusion correctly.
summary: Front-to-Back Layer Traversal is a rendering strategy for Matryoshka structures that processes cells in front-to-back order using pre-defined layers and an auxiliary buffer to handle occlusion without per-ray depth sorting.
